findings.title: Rate multiplication may overflow or lose precision
findings.body: `amount_cents * rate` multiplies an `int` by a `Decimal`, producing a `Decimal` that is then rounded to an `int`. This risks overflow for large amounts and loses precision when the product is not an integer. Call `fetch_rate` with the correct currency pair and use `Decimal` arithmetic throughout.

findings.title: Synchronous call in async function
findings.body: `fetch_rate` is an async function, but it is called synchronously on line 16. This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime because an async function must be awaited. Use `await fetch_rate(pair)` instead.

summary.problem: The new async function performs a synchronous call to an async function and performs unsafe arithmetic, risking runtime errors and incorrect results.
summary.done_well: The function signature and docstring clearly describe the intended conversion and its units.
